messages.subject: How to redirect output of script?
parts:
Hi,
I'm using this approach to redirect the output:

            ScriptEngineManager factory = new ScriptEngineManager();
            ScriptEngine engine = factory.getEngineByName("Renjin");
            ScriptContext context = engine.getContext();
            context.setWriter(writer);
            context.setErrorWriter(writer);
            engine.eval(reader, context);

doesn't seem to work...

thanx in advance

messages.subject: Re: How to redirect output of script?
parts:
Ok, there is a way through the session:

            Session session = engine.getSession();
            session.setStdErr(printWriter);
            session.setStdOut(printWriter);
